page.layout: One column of running text, with line numbers 5 to 35 in the left margin beside the text. Three paragraphs: the continuation from the previous page, then the theses XVI and XVII. A strip at the left edge shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Running head centred at the top, page number top right, catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.l: quâ quis ita obseruat ritus & ceremonias sacras,
vt illæ ancillentur fidei, spei & charitati. Religio
vera est interna, vel externa. De religione internâ sic pro-
nuntiat apostolus Iacobus c. 1. v. vlt. Religio pura & inconta-

l.i: minata apud Deum & Patrem, hæc est, inuisere orphanos & vi-
duas in afflictione ipsorum, & immaculatum sese seruare a mundo.

main_text.l: Ex quâ definitione intelligimus, religionem veram & in-
ternam complecti dilectionem Dei & proximi, adeoque
totum Christianismum. Religio vera externa consistit
in obseruatione ceremoniarum a Deo præscriptarum: c-
uiusmodi in V. T. fuerunt sacrificia, conuiuia sacra, certæ
lotiones, abstinentia a certis cibis, jeiunia, adoratio co-
ram arcâ fœderis & versus templum, circumcisio, & agnus
paschalis: in N. T. prædicatio & auscultatio verbi Dei
so-lennis, & usurpatio sacramentorum prout a Christo sunt
instituta. Horum rituum obseruatio hactenus probatur
Deo, si ancillētur fidei, spei & charitati. Psalm. 50. Esa. 1.
tem prohibentur, repræsentatio Dei per imagines, appro-
batio externæ idololatriæ, magici ritus & illorum appro-
batio.
XVI. Societas cum religionis studiosis est,
quando cum iis conuersamur, qui Deum colunt
ritibus cum verbo ipsius non pugnantibus. Huc
pertinent connubia, fœdera, conuiuia, & similia.2.Chron.

l.i: 15. vers. 10. c. 19. vers. 2. Mal. 2. vers. 11. 1. Cor. 6. v. 1. & seqq.

main_text.l: XVII. Sanctificatio nominis Dei est, qua vti-
mur nomine Dei sancte: hoc est, cum celebratione,
veracitate, reuerentiâ, & circumspectione, vt sermo nos-
ter exprimat virtutes primi præcepti. Deut. 8. vers. 8. c. 10. v.
8.1. Sam. 2. v. 20. Sanè cum auiculæ omnesq; aliæ crea-
turæ sonent laudem Dei, & pro modulo quæque suo glo-
riam eius enarrent, foedissimum fuerit, si nos hanc musi-
cam & harmoniam ingrato stridore violemus. Psal. 19.

page.notes: The strip at the left edge (fragments such as "lebita", "folum", "Deum", "luere") is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. The marginal numbers 5 to 35 are printed line numbers and are kept as notes. The printed "& 29." at the foot is given as the catchword; this is uncertain. Reading of "sese seruare" as "sese seruare" is taken from the scan. Reference numbers are copied as printed.
